summary: Defines the core error handling schemas, including base errors, domain-specific error classes for AI, configuration, database, I/O, validation, and timeouts, along with associated retry and resolution strategies.
responsibilities: Defines error classes, types, phases, operations, and resolution strategies for AI, configuration, database, I/O, timeout, validation, and general application operations.
design_decisions: Object-oriented error hierarchies with domain-specific subclasses and resolution strategies
